WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.Name,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.Bytes, 0)) as total_bytes,
    SUM(t.Milliseconds) as total_milliseconds,
    CAST(SUM(COALESCE(t.Bytes, 0)) as REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as byte_rate,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count
  FROM MediaType mt
  JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    mts.byte_rate,
    mts.track_count,
    mts.byte_rate - ar.avg_rate as excess
  FROM media_type_stats mts
  CROSS JOIN average_rate ar
  WHERE mts.byte_rate > ar.avg_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(byte_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average
